Name: Long-Lasting Espresso
Author: dragonsir
Description:
[size=5]May not be currently compatible with 1.6 Update:[/size]

I am currently working on all of my mods to make them compatible with 1.6. Please use at your own risk or wait until a compatible version is available.


[line]


Do you get sick and tired of having to chug espresso when your speed lowers? Doesn't it always happen at the worst time, like when you're swarmed with dragons in the Skull Cavern? Do you hate having to grow 15 gosh darn coffee plants and wait for them to brew in a keg and then walk to the kitchen just to make 1 friggin' espresso that only lasts a third of the day??? Well, this mod is for you!

This mod simply changes the espresso's speed boost to 14 minutes instead of 4. That is enough to last from 6 am to 1:30 am, or 13.5 hours in-game. Now your espresso lasts 3 times as long and you don't have to grow so many beans!

[size=5]
Installation[/size]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip this file into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
